hero.eyebrow: Fine art and documentary photographer · London
hero.title: Womanhood, through *identity,* memory and the body
hero.text: Beatriz Perez is a London-based fine art and documentary photography artist whose work explores womanhood through themes of cultural identity, memory and the body. Drawing from personal history and symbolism, her images combine staged and documentary approaches to examine how women are seen, remembered and represented within contemporary photography.
hero.image_alt: Three generations of women sharing la merienda at a garden table in Spain
hero.caption: La Merienda, Spain

projects_text: Ongoing photographic explorations of womanhood through conceptual and narrative fine art and documentary photography. Moving between intimacy and performance, the images unfold as visual narratives shaped by cultural memory, symbolic gestures and personal experience.

about.text: I am a fine art and documentary photographer exploring womanhood through themes of cultural identity, memory and the body. My work combines conceptual staging with documentary approaches to construct visual narratives, drawing on symbolism, personal history and lived experiences.
